concepts.gloss_en: "we will hear" (nishma, from na'aseh v'nishma) — the aspect of the hidden/prayer/fear

reason_for_human: All 10 occurrences are the same word — נִשְׁמָע/נִשְׁמַע, "we will hear" from the phrase na'aseh v'nishma — consistently glossed as the aspect of the hidden (nistar), prayer (tefillah), and fear. The pausal נִשְׁמָע vs. contextual נִשְׁמַע difference is ordinary pausal variation of one word, not a homograph. No competing meaning appears in any context.
